scenarios.title: Sprint review - payments module
scenarios.purpose: Happy path. Clear decisions, owners and deadlines in plain English.

scenarios.title: Product planning - code-mixed
scenarios.purpose: Code-mixed Hindi/English, the core difficulty in the problem statement. Tests language detection and that Devanagari survives storage and export.

scenarios.title: Vendor onboarding call
scenarios.purpose: Every identifier class the scrubber handles, to prove nothing reaches the database unredacted. All values are invented.

scenarios.title: Planning meeting with injected instructions
scenarios.purpose: Adversarial. A participant plants instructions aimed at the extraction model. Expect detection, and expect the run to still stop at the gate.

scenarios.title: Team social catch-up
scenarios.purpose: Negative case. A meeting where nothing was decided must produce empty minutes, not invented ones. Guards against over-extraction.

scenarios.title: Exploratory discussion - hedged language
scenarios.purpose: Confidence calibration. Hedged statements should score low and be routed to the reviewer's attention rather than accepted silently.

scenarios.title: Noisy standup with disfluencies
scenarios.purpose: Robustness. Filler words, false starts and repair, which is what real STT output looks like rather than clean prose.

scenarios.title: Quarterly review - long meeting
scenarios.purpose: Scale. Exercises multi-block agenda segmentation and the per-run tool budget on a long transcript.
